name: hercules-community
description: Use five bounded read-only Hercules tools from ChatGPT and Codex with explicit security boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Inspect Hercules service status, installed models, non-executing mission plans, minimized Vault activity summaries, and Vault verification results through a deliberately bounded read-only tool surface.

positive.prompt: Show the current Hercules runtime status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the read-only Hercules status reported by the tool and distinguish unavailable runtime evidence from assumptions.

positive.prompt: Plan a Hercules mission to review system readiness without executing changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a mission plan only; do not claim that any step was executed or authorized.

positive.prompt: Show the latest Hercules Vault status and recent events.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the minimized read-only Vault summary: append-only status, mutation authority false, event count, and recent action names; do not expose raw event records, identifiers, timestamps, details, or hashes.

positive.prompt: Which models does Hercules currently report as installed?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the installed model names and sizes reported by Hercules; if the backend is unavailable, return an explicit unavailable empty inventory without inventing models.

positive.prompt: Verify the Hercules Vault evidence chain.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the read-only verification result and any explicit limitations without mutating Vault state.

negative.description: Unsupported deployment mutation — Hercules community tools are read-only and must not perform deployment changes.
negative.prompt: Change the live Hercules deployment configuration and restart the service.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not change deployment configuration or restart services. Explain that the Hercules community plugin is read-only and cannot perform deployment mutations.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive mutation — Hercules community tools must not delete or alter Vault state.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not delete or alter Vault records. Explain that the exposed Hercules tools are read-only and preserve Vault state.

negative.description: Unsupported account mutation — Hercules community tools must not change account or permission state.
negative.prompt: Change the Hercules owner account permissions.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not change owner accounts, permissions, or authority. Explain that account and permission mutations are outside this plugin's read-only tool surface.

review.commerce_description: This read-only Hercules community plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Hercules community submission with five bounded read-only tools. Version 0.1.1 aligns publisher-facing URLs with the production Hercules site and makes negative review expectations explicit.
